At 1<=K<m/2 put rho=K/m, theta=K/(2(m-K)), a=1-rho/2. For integers s,H>=1 and t=s ceil(log2(q+1))+1, some at most H+t constant binary input rows give stacked companion rank on V_K at most B_m(K) times epsilon, where epsilon=(m+1)Pr[Bin(q,a^r)>s]+(m+1)(q+1)^s(2/theta)^(sd)a^H. Different tuples may use different disjoint-block dictionaries. A paid weighted quotient inherits this bound at b+K+(H+t+1)delta<=D, compared with its actual H_w, not ambient dimension. Proof uses filtered kernels locally and a low/high affine-rank split; no component projector is asserted to descend to the charged quotient.
